slides.title: Cost visibility per member bank and workload, with guardrails inside your own Snowflake and Azure
bullets: Snowflake usage, Azure cost data and Power BI capacity are combined in one cost model, tagged by member bank and workload. Guardrails stop runaway spend before the invoice.

Attribution: query and role tags where warehouses are per bank, usage-based allocation where shared; the remainder goes to a visible 'unallocated' line that you approve. Baseline = at least 3 months of usage, read-only roles, signed off by you.
Everything runs in your tenant in the EU. No data goes to non-European AI toolchains.
DORA: an ICT-risk register entry per tool, an exit plan, and an audit log of every guardrail change.

columns.title: Cost sources
boxes: Temenos feeds via your Snowflake loads

diagram.band: Inventory method: scan Snowflake external functions, integrations, tasks and query history, plus Azure app registrations and egress. Each finding is remove, replace or exit plan and feeds the DORA register; replacing a pipeline over 2 days is a change request after Definition

slides.title: Savings levers we measure against your baseline, and the controls your regulators expect
table: How it is measured or proven
AI-driven example: Recordly's Virtual Data Engineer
Agents in your Snowflake propose cost and performance fixes as pull requests; your change board approves each one
Credits per workload before and after
Query and model optimisation for top spenders
EU-only processing, no foreign AI toolchain
Inventory and decision log (DORA ICT risk)
slides.note: Phases: definition = baseline + toolchain inventory; delivery = guardrails and optimisation; ongoing = monthly review. Savings targets are set after the baseline; we do not quote % savings before measuring. Guardrails go live alert-only for 2 weeks, then enforce; hard suspend only on non-production warehouses; every change is code with rollback. Read-only access in Definition, write access only in Delivery on approved changes. Out of scope: re-platforming; a flagged pipeline over 2 days to replace is a change request.
